description: meta ads must haves: episode 3 🎬 the very first thing meta asks you when you create a campaign is what your objective is, and this decision matters way more than most people realize. your objective tells meta what to optimize for. it changes how the algorithm behaves, who sees your ad, and what actions it's trying to get people to take. here's the quick breakdown of all 6: 🎯 awareness — reach as many people as possible. top of funnel, seed planting only. don't expect sales. 🖱️ traffic — drive clicks to a page. great for warming people up but remember — clicks don't equal conversions. ❤️ engagement — likes, comments, shares, video views. amazing for building social proof and warming cold audiences before hitting them with a sales campaign. 📋 leads — collect contact info directly inside meta via a native lead form. perfect for service based businesses and email list building. 📱 app promotion — driving app installs or in-app actions. niche but worth knowing. 💰 sales — find people who will actually buy. this is the one I live in for my ecom clients and it's where the magic happens when you have enough data behind it. knowing which objective to use and WHY is what separates a media buyer who actually understands the platform from someone just clicking buttons and hoping for the best. follow for episode 4, we’re talking budgeting 👆 #metaads #facebookads #instagramads #mediabuyerlife #freelancemediabuyer
